description: Calculate Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty (ABSD) plus BSD on a Singapore residential purchase, by buyer profile (Singapore Citizen, PR, foreigner, entity) and number of residential properties already owned. Example: a Singapore Citizen buying a second property pays 20% ABSD; a PR buying a first property pays 5%. From Propely (propely.sg), the owner-direct condo marketplace in Singapore. Indicative figures, not legal or financial advice.

profile.description: sc = Singapore Citizen, pr = Permanent Resident, foreign = foreigner, entity = company or other entity

propertiesOwned.description: Residential properties the buyer already owns (overseas excluded): 0, 1, or 2 for two or more

name: calculate_absd
title: Singapore Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty (ABSD)
